When the user explicitly returns to earlier work, reuse its exact saved artifact reference only if available in the conversation; never guess missing references. For follow-ups, reuse the latest unambiguous user-supplied location, dates and other constraints. Do not carry stale filters into unrelated requests. Ask only for missing or ambiguous details.
